name: Processor A (5q baseline, branching T-tree)
design_rationale: Kept equal to the guide's branching-tree baseline: it is the sparsest connected 5-qubit graph that still has a degree-3 hub (qubit 1) and mirrors real 5-qubit IBM Falcon devices.  4 edges vs the 10 edges a dense K5 Ising cost layer needs => it acts as the 'connectivity-starved' control of the co-design experiment.
